Do not rely on another answer to fill a gap. If the summary does not resolve a requested part, identify it as unsupported rather than guessing. Check volunteered statements for contradictions with the summary.
For every question include id, answer, support (supported, partial or unsupported), evidence (a short quote or section from the summary).
Save valid JSON to /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/scythe/2026-11-04-batch-231507/post-change-20261106-02/reader-a.json with top-level fields reader, inputs_read and answers (an array).
